hero.title: Logistics solutions for long-term partnerships
hero.intro: UAB TRANSGARANT GROUP is a privately owned transport and logistics company providing comprehensive logistics services. We specialise in freight transport and forwarding.
hero.imageAlt: Cargo being prepared in a logistics warehouse

overview.title: Experience that helps find the right solution
overview.badgeAlt: Creditinfo rating “Strongest in Lithuania 2020–2026” – UAB “TRANSGARANT GROUP”
paragraphs: Our experience transporting cargo on domestic and international routes enables us to offer solutions tailored to each client’s needs. We use our own vehicles and a trusted partner network to organise every shipment.
We specialise in transporting small, partial and full loads by road. An extensive partner network across Europe helps us deliver cargo to the consignee or warehouse safely, efficiently and on time.
Our responsible approach is focused on long-term cooperation and dependable partnerships. We believe that quality logistics services help our clients develop their businesses successfully.
overview.highlight: Our goal is not only to complete every order to a high standard, but also to exceed our client’s expectations.
